scientific_integrity: Exact analytic derivation; finite symbolic and numerical calculations are reproducibility checks, not proofs of infinite-time behavior. No claims of experimental observations, independent review, or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the critical boundary subfamily a=alpha=0, e=1/4, c+d=3/4 is addressed.
The nonzero algebraic constants require x3(0) different from 2/5; on that hyperplane the convergence is geometric.
No quantitative uniform-in-parameter error bound or extension to general quadratic stochastic maps is proved.
A general parabolic-flip normal form can recover the scalar square-root rate; the novelty claim is the exact species-resolved transverse coefficient and selective ratio classification.
Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive historical-priority review have not been performed.
title: A two-to-five selective relaxation resonance in a quadratic stochastic population map
